subtitulo: Your plan, the video hours you've used this month, and billing.
sinPlan: Your account has no billing plan: your brands have no limits. To add a new brand with a free trial, create it from the brand selector.

estados.prueba: The trial ends on {fecha} ({dias, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}).
estados.pruebaTermino: The free trial has ended. Choose a plan to keep uploading videos; everything you made is still available.
estados.cancelada: Cancelled: stays active until {fecha}. You can resume it from Manage billing.
estados.pagoPendiente: We couldn't charge the last renewal and we're retrying. Check your card in Manage billing.
estados.vencida: Your plan isn't active: new videos can't be uploaded. Choose a plan to come back; everything you made is still available.

horasSuman: Video hours add up across all your brands. Clips and exports are unlimited.
cambiado: Done: we changed your plan. The difference is charged now, prorated.
procesandoPago: We're confirming your payment. Your plan will update in a few seconds.
cobroNoListo: Payments aren't enabled yet. If you want a plan now, write to {correo}.
custom: Need more than 80 hours a month? <correo>Write to us</correo> and we'll set up a Custom plan.
lemon: Payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy, which issues the invoice. You can cancel anytime.
